rapport_notes: Outstanding genuine warmth — built real trust with a customer who disclosed being blind and the recent loss of a service dog, without ever feeling scripted.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "before we get kind of the specifics, do you have any specific concerns or questions that you want answered on this call in regards to your move?" (asked before logistics probing)
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: "So, you want, you still want to pack your smaller items into boxes and things" — single follow-up on the packing-help concern raised by a blind customer, then pivoted into explaining the packing service rather than digging further
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "how well prepared you are when we get there and making sure that everything's packed up... take some of those small things over yourself in a car... that helps keep time down" (self-prep tip); close: "Would you like us to help you out with your move?"

top_strength: Outstanding rapport and genuine listening — built real trust with a customer who disclosed sensitive personal details, and it clearly contributed to an easy, warm booking.
coaching_note: The blindness/packing-help concern got only one clarifying question before pivoting into the packing-service pitch — real two-layer digging (what specifically would make this easier, anything else on your mind) would have been high-value given the trust already extended.
